Your first visit

You do not need a referral, and you do not need to know what is wrong. Most people who come to us only know that something hurts and has done for a while. That is enough to start with.

The first appointment is 50 minutes. We spend about half of it talking: what you do all day, how you sleep, what you have already tried. Then we look at how you move, gently, and we stop whenever you ask.

What to bring

Wear something you can move in. Bring any scans or letters you already have, and a list of the medicines you take. If you would like someone with you, they are welcome in the room.

Afterwards

You leave with a plain explanation of what we found, two or three exercises that take ten minutes a day, and an honest guess at how many visits you will need. For most people it is between four and six.

A first visit costs 68 euros. If you need to cancel, tell us the day before and there is no charge.
